node.title: Re: How encode space into %20 in URI
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
is there a easy/nice way to do this work in URL?

Could you explain to us why you need this? It is perfectly valid for spaces to be escaped as +, it's the standard as per [https://www.w3.org/TR/html4/interact/forms.html#h-17.13.4.1|HTML 4], and it's optional in [https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#string-percent-encode-after-encoding|HTML 5].
